create_optimizer_bounded_adam: create a BoundedAdam optimizer with custom learning rate, betas, and epsilon for differentiable rendering
set_parameter_bounds: set upper and lower bounds on optimizer parameters to constrain gradient descent steps
compute_l1_loss: compute the L1 loss between a reference image and a rendered image using Dr.Jit operations
compute_l2_loss: compute the L2 loss between a reference image and a rendered image using Dr.Jit operations
compute_psnr_metric: compute the PSNR metric between a reference image and a rendered image for quality evaluation
